Princeton, NJ
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE

Description:

WonderBotz is seeking a motivated Junior Consultant to join our growing team in Princeton, NJ. This role is ideal for recent graduates or professionals with up to 1–2 years of experience who have strong technical fundamentals, a problem-solving mindset, and a passion for learning emerging technologies.

Role and Responsibilities:

Assist in designing, developing, and implementing automation and AI solutions.
Work with clients and internal teams to understand business requirements.
Develop and support solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, and automation technologies.
Participate in troubleshooting, testing, and deployment activities.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Qualifications for the ideal candidate: 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong programming fundamentals and analytical skills.
Knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, and AI and Machine Learning concepts
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced consulting environment.
1–2 years of experience in the RPA (Robotic Process Automation) industry is a plus.
Exposure to automation technologies such as: UiPath , Automation Anywhere and Blue Prism
Experience working on automation, AI, or digital transformation projects

Desired characteristics in candidates

Self-motivated, able to take the initiative with minimal need for supervision.
Effective communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences
Highly motivated, organized, and methodical, but can handle change in stride.
Analytical and proven problem-solving skills
High emotional IQ
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Demonstrated willingness to dive into the details to guide projects to completion.
Team orientation rather than an individual contributor
Insatiable work ethic

Compensation and start dates.

Hiring now for an immediate start
Salary: Competitive pay determined by level and experience
Benefits: Healthcare, relocation, vacation, holidays
Willingness to work onsite in Princeton, NJ.

WonderBotz is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
